scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run fastapi dev app/main.py
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T db psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U mvdt -d mvdt < database/seed.sql
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.db:seed:assets: cd apps/api && uv run python -m scripts.seed_dev
scripts.db:seed:media: cd apps/api && uv run python -m scripts.seed_media
scripts.research:audit: cd apps/api && uv run python -m scripts.audit_research_readiness --output ../../research/evaluation/readiness_audit.json
scripts.test:research: cd apps/api && uv run python -m pytest tests/test_research.py tests/test_empirical.py tests/test_initial_research_batch.py -q
